subject: Hosted API IO economics & supported models — Lumina Health inquiry
messages:
From: Alice Nguyen <alice@luminahealth.ai>
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 9 May 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted API IO economics & model roster

Hi Diego,

Quick intro — I'm Alice (Head of Integrations) at Lumina Health. We're evaluating hosted inference providers for a conversational assistant + summarization pipeline and I was hoping to get a concise baseline from you today to put into our vendor scorecard. Specifically: 

- Standard per-1M token pricing split for input vs output for your Hosted API (USD).
- Is there a separate rate for embeddings or are they the same IO units?
- A short list of recommended models for low-latency (sub-200ms token) vs best-quality for summarization.
- What typical discount bands exist for committed POC volumes (we expect ~10M/month during a 3-month POC) and for a production run (~100M/month sustained).

If you can also attach a simple PDF rate sheet and a one-page model roster, that would be ideal. We're on a tight timeline and would like to finalize vendor short-listing by next Tuesday.

Thanks — happy to share projected monthly token profiles if that helps.

Alice Nguyen
Head of Integrations, Lumina Health
alice@luminahealth.ai
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Nguyen <alice@luminahealth.ai>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 9 May 2027 10:36:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API IO economics & model roster

Hi Alice — thanks for the clear ask and timeline. Pushing a concise summary below and attaching our baseline PDF (redwood-hosted-baseline-rates-q2-2027.pdf). Happy to iterate based on your projected mix.

Baseline (Hosted API, public list, USD per 1M tokens):
- Input tokens: $0.90 / 1M
- Output tokens: $3.20 / 1M
- Embeddings: $1.25 / 1M (separate product SKU)

Model guidance (recommended):
- Low-latency / cost-sensitive: rdx-small-1.0 (quantized variant) — good for short-turn chat, sub-200ms on our hosted tier.
- Balanced: rdx-medium-1.2 — stronger instruction-following and summarization quality.
- High-quality summarization / long-form: rdx-large-2.0 (best F1/ROUGE in our evals).

Discount bands (indicative, negotiable):
- POC (>= 5M/mo): 10% off baseline list rates for first 3 months.
- Mid commit (>= 50M/mo sustained): 18% off baseline.
- Enterprise (>= 200M/mo): 30% off baseline + options for dedicated capacity pricing.

Next steps: could you share a rough monthly token split (input vs output vs embeddings) and whether you need streaming or function-calling behavior? I'll loop in Laura (cc'd) to get a formal quote and a one-page mutual action plan if you want to proceed to POC.

Attaching: redwood-hosted-baseline-rates-q2-2027.pdf

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Principal Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
diego_fernandez@redwood.ai
+1 (650) 555-0202

From: Alice Nguyen <alice@luminahealth.ai>
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai
Cc: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@luminahealth.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 08:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API IO economics & model roster

Thanks Diego — that is exactly what we need to start. A couple follow-ups / clarifications: 

1) For our use case the expected steady-state profile is roughly: 3M input tokens / month, 7M output tokens / month (chat + multi-turn), plus ~500k embedding tokens for indexing use. For the POC month-to-month, we anticipate a modest spike to ~15M combined IO.
2) Do the discount bands apply across IO + embeddings combined or are embeddings excluded from the volume tiers?
3) Can you confirm whether rdx-medium-1.2 supports function-calling and structured JSON output (we rely on structured responses for downstream ingestion)?

I've attached a short outline of the POC objectives so you have context (Lumina_POC_outline.pdf). Would appreciate a written quote for the 3-month POC and the sustained 100M/mo scenario.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — goal is to have a written quote and technical sign-off by EOD Wednesday so procurement can start paperwork.

— Alice

(attachment: Lumina_POC_outline.pdf)

From: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Nguyen <alice@luminahealth.ai>, Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@luminahealth.ai>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 11:19:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API IO economics & model roster

Alice — copying our AE and pricing lead to get you a formal quote. Quick answers inline and an internal note below.

- Discount stacking: embeddings are counted toward total billable units for tier qualification, but embeddings keep their own SKU rate. In other words, volume tiers are met by aggregate units across SKUs.
- rdx-medium-1.2: yes, it supports function-calling and structured JSON output with our streaming responses; we include schema enforcement helpers in the SDK.

(Internal note to Laura & Vivek) — Lumina fits our mid-market POC profile. They expect ~15M token spike during POC and ~100M sustained if we win. Recommend we offer: 12% POC discount (slightly above list 10%) to be competitive; for 100M committed, propose 20% enterprise discount (limit to hosted; offer dedicated pricing as a separate add-on). Attach a 1-page mutual action plan I can use in demo.

Next steps for Lumina: Vivek, can you own the formal quote (include a 30-day POC SOW with the 12% POC discount and the 20% committed tier for 100M)? Laura, please prepare a short note on SLA and support response times for procurement. Alice — I'll have the official PDF quote and a mutual action plan over to you by EOD Wednesday.

Attachments: Lumina_Mutual_Action_Plan.xlsx

Thanks,
Diego
